question: Which mountain range prevents the cold Siberian winds from entering India?
solution:
The correct answer is__** the Himalayas.**__

__** [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] Key Points__**

__
 
• **The Himalayas are the mountain range that prevents the cold Siberian winds from entering India.**
 
• These winds are extremely **cold and dry and can cause a lot of damage to crops and other vegetation if they were to enter India.**
 
• The Himalayas are the highest mountain range in the world, and they run across the northern border of India.
 
• They are also home to some of the highest peaks in the world, including Mount Everest.
 
• The Satpura Range is a mountain range in central India, and it does not prevent the cold Siberian winds from entering India. The Aravali Hills are a range of mountains in western India, and they also do not prevent the cold Siberian winds from entering India.
 
• The Western Ghats are a mountain range that runs along the western coast of India, and they do not prevent the cold Siberian winds from entering India. However, they do play an important role in the monsoon season by blocking the southwest monsoon winds from entering the interior of India.
